name: timetable-hero
title: Timetable hero
description: A studio opening with today's sessions in a row of tiles: time, class, coach and spots left, each a link to book.
docs: Pass the coming sessions with a start time as an ISO string with its offset (2026-11-04T18:30:00+01:00) and the studio's own timeZone: times and days are written in that zone, whatever the visitor's clock says. The hero shows today's sessions in the studio's zone and, when none are left, the first one of the next day with sessions. Leave `now` out and the browser's clock is read once the page is live; pass it for server HTML, tests and previews. On a small screen the row opens on the first class that has not begun, so the next one you can book leads.
